name: Price Source 2 Code
definition: Specifies the source of a price quotation.

FUND.name: Fund
FUND.definition: Source of price quotation is a fund, eg, transfer agent, fund itself.

THEO.name: Theoretical
THEO.definition: Source of price quotation is a theoretical value based on the market yield.

VEND.name: Vendor
VEND.definition: Source of price quotation is an external vendor.

EXCH.name: Stock Exchange
EXCH.definition: Source of price quotation is a stock exchange.
